tracks.title: Before the Distance
tracks.loreNote: A mid-tempo 1980s pop-rock power anthem opening Progress Street, famously listened to by Jessica on her Quantum Zephyr during her November 2006 commuter train ride.

tracks.title: Seconds into Forever
tracks.loreNote: Soaring synth-rock anthem capturing the rush of eternal moments under Virginia skies.

tracks.title: Thunder in the Rain
tracks.loreNote: Electrifying heavy 80s synth-rock crescendo with torrential rain and lightning guitar energy.
